envoy.title: Envoy
envoy.summary: Open source edge and service proxy; the gateway that routes requests to each service.

icebergRestSpec.title: Iceberg REST Catalog
icebergRestSpec.summary: Open specification for an Iceberg catalog served over REST: engines use it to create, load, and commit Iceberg tables through any conforming catalog.

lakehouse.catalog.title: Catalog
lakehouse.catalog.summary: The metadata authority: a registry of tables, schemas, and access that every query resolves through.

lakehouse.credential.title: Credential
lakehouse.credential.summary: A catalogued cloud identity the catalog uses to mint scoped storage credentials.

lakehouse.externalLocation.title: External location
lakehouse.externalLocation.summary: A governed object-storage path, paired with the credential that can reach it.

lakehouse.function.title: Function
lakehouse.function.summary: A governed, reusable unit of computation.

lakehouse.metricView.title: Metric view
lakehouse.metricView.summary: A view that declares measures and dimensions, so every engine computes a metric the same way.

lakehouse.modelTracking.title: Model tracking
lakehouse.modelTracking.summary: Tracks experiments, versions models, and governs their promotion to production.

lakehouse.namespace.title: Namespace
lakehouse.namespace.summary: The namespace container other asset kinds are organized under.

lakehouse.objectStorage.title: Object storage
lakehouse.objectStorage.summary: Stores data as flat objects (blobs) addressed by key, not as a file hierarchy.

lakehouse.queryEngine.title: Query engine
lakehouse.queryEngine.summary: Parses, plans, and executes queries over open table formats.

lakehouse.sqlView.title: View
lakehouse.sqlView.summary: A named query over tables, resolved and run by the query engine.

lakehouse.table.title: Table
lakehouse.table.summary: The tabular securable — rows and columns with ACID semantics.

lakehouse.volume.title: Volume
lakehouse.volume.summary: A governed directory: a catalog name for a storage path that holds files, usually non-tabular.

mlflow.title: MLflow
mlflow.summary: Open source platform for the ML lifecycle: experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment.

postgresql.title: PostgreSQL
postgresql.summary: Open source relational database; the metadata store behind catalog and tracking services.

rustfs.title: RustFS
rustfs.summary: S3-compatible object storage server written in Rust.

unityCatalogDeltaApiSpec.title: Unity Catalog Delta API
unityCatalogDeltaApiSpec.summary: Open specification for catalog-managed Delta tables over REST: an engine negotiates the protocol version, stages and creates a table with the table features the catalog requires, and commits through intent-based updates guarded by preconditions, all or nothing.

unityCatalogServer.title: Unity Catalog (OSS)
unityCatalogServer.summary: The open-source reference server implementing the Unity Catalog specification.

unityCatalogSpec.title: Unity Catalog
unityCatalogSpec.summary: Open catalog specification for data & AI: a catalog governing tables, files, functions, and models across engines.
